issues.description: The provided solution defines the Lecture constructor with package-private visibility (no access modifier). The problem statement asks students to "Create a constructor that initializes every attribute" and the template leaves a public-facing constructor as the expected implementation. A package-private constructor may prevent instantiation from other packages (for example, external tests or example code in other packages) and can confuse students about the intended visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Lecture constructor public in both the template (when providing a signature example) and the solution. Change the constructor declaration to: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } This ensures students and external tests can instantiate Lecture as intended.
